security_spec.violation_condition: PSUB.DB, PSUB.DH, and PSUB.DW are specified as RV32-only instructions using OP-IMM-32 major opcode with 4-bit register-pair fields (rs1_p/rs2_p/rd_p at non-standard bit positions). If XiangShan's RV64 decoder does not trap these encodings as illegal instructions in RV64 mode, the 4-bit pair fields would be misinterpreted—either aliasing with valid RV64 instruction encodings in the OP-IMM-32 space or causing the register file to index X[odd*2] and X[odd*2+1] derived from truncated 4-bit specifiers, silently reading from and writing to wrong architectural registers.
security_spec.vulnerability_pattern: decoder does not check misa.P/XLEN mode before dispatching PSUB.DB|PSUB.DH|PSUB.DW encodings; funct3=0x6 with OP-IMM-32(0x1b) accepted in RV64 mode; register-pair index derived from 4-bit field without trapping when XLEN=64
security_spec.summary: PSUB.DB/DH/DW are RV32-only register-pair instructions encoded in OP-IMM-32 space; executing them in XiangShan's RV64 mode without illegal-instruction trapping causes 4-bit register-pair fields to be misinterpreted, resulting in wrong-register data corruption
